title: Arctic Reindeer: Why Reindeer Eyes Turn Deep Blue in Winter!

lines.text: Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer had a very shiny nose!
lines.caps: Rudolph the red-nosed *REINDEER | had a very *SHINY | *NOSE!

lines.text: But reindeer have an even wilder superpower in their eyes!
lines.caps: But reindeer have an even *WILDER | superpower in their *EYES!

lines.text: In bright summer, reindeer eyes shine with a sparkling golden color!
lines.caps: In bright *SUMMER, | reindeer eyes shine with a *SPARKLING | golden *COLOR!

lines.text: But during dark arctic winters, their eyes turn deep, ocean blue!
lines.caps: But during dark arctic *WINTERS, | their eyes turn *DEEP, | ocean *BLUE!

lines.text: The constant winter darkness makes their pupils stretch wide open day and night!
lines.caps: The constant winter *DARKNESS | makes their pupils stretch wide *OPEN | day and *NIGHT!

lines.text: This pressure tightens the reflective mirror behind their retinas!
lines.caps: This pressure *TIGHTENS | the reflective mirror behind *THEIR | *RETINAS!

lines.text: Blue eyes scatter moonlight, letting reindeer spot hidden lichen beneath the snow!
lines.caps: Blue eyes scatter moonlight, *LETTING | reindeer spot hidden lichen *BENEATH | the *SNOW!

lines.text: Now you know the real arctic magic behind Santa's reindeer!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the real arctic *MAGIC | behind Santa's *REINDEER!
